message.content: Audit generated floor plans across multiple plot sizes and programmes (`scripts/plan_audit.py`) to identify why tight plots produce narrow slot rooms and why generous plots (e.g. 60x40) produce undersized footprints.

content.thinking: A slicing-tree partition always tiles whatever envelope it is given, so an over-stuffed brief produces 1.5m-wide bedrooms unless feasibility is checked first. Conversely, on a 40x60m plot, rooms must scale up to sensible luxury caps and add a family lounge, study, verandah or courtyard to fill the footprint.

content.thinking: Locking the staircase cuts at the root of the slicing tree guarantees identical stair coordinates across every floor even after 200 crossover and mutation steps. Aspect penalties above 1.6:1 and hard caps per room type prevent slot rooms.
